summary.text: Noel Williams Jr. represents District 148 in the Georgia House of Representatives and was sworn in on January 14, 2019.

paragraphs.text: He graduated from the University of Georgia in 1994 with a political science degree.

According to the legislature biography, he worked 13 years for Life of the South Insurance Agency and has been with Partners Benefit Group since 2007, and his family has lived in Cordele for over 20 years.
